title: Storm Sorceress Over Armada
description: A white-haired female figure with large glowing blue wings and armor floats in the stormy sky, holding a glowing staff above a massive swirling blue vortex of water and runes. Below, a chaotic naval battle unfolds with old wooden sailing ships and modern fighter jets on turbulent seas under dark lightning-filled clouds.
prompt: A powerful white-haired sorceress with large glowing cyan wings and intricate silver armor floats dramatically in a stormy sky, holding a glowing blue staff. Below her is a massive swirling vortex of turquoise water with glowing runes. A chaotic fleet of historical wooden sailing ships and modern fighter jets battle on rough seas under dark clouds with lightning, epic fantasy digital painting.
